tools.name: grant_matter_access
tools.description: Grants a firm user a role on a legal matter, such as viewer, editor, or responsible attorney, so they can work with the matter's documents. If the user already has a role on the matter, it is replaced with the new one.

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email address of the firm user who is getting access.

params.name: granted_by
params.description: Email of the attorney approving the access.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("matter-access")

DB_PATH = "/srv/legal/matters.db"
_ALLOWED_ROLES = {"viewer", "editor", "responsible_attorney"}


@mcp.tool()
def grant_matter_access(matter_id: str, user_email: str, role: str, granted_by: str) -> dict:
    result = {"matter_id": matter_id, "user_email": user_email, "role": role, "granted": False}
    if role not in _ALLOWED_ROLES:
        result["error"] = f"Unsupported role '{role}'"
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        matter = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM matters WHERE matter_id = ?", (matter_id,)).fetchone()
        if matter is None:
            result["error"] = "Matter not found"
            return result
        previous = conn.execute(
            "SELECT role FROM matter_permissions WHERE matter_id = ? AND user_email = ?",
            (matter_id, user_email),
        ).fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO matter_permissions (matter_id, user_email, role, granted_by, granted_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(matter_id, user_email) DO UPDATE SET "
            "role = excluded.role, granted_by = excluded.granted_by, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
            (matter_id, user_email, role, granted_by, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result["granted"] = True
    result["previous_role"] = previous[0] if previous else None
    result["granted_by"] = granted_by
    return result

tools.name: run_pdf_integrity_check
tools.description: Runs the qpdf checker on a pleading or exhibit PDF to confirm its structure is valid before filing. Returns the checker's findings without changing the file.

params.name: document_path
params.description: Path to the PDF document to check.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the check run. Defaults to 60.

tools.name: withdraw_court_efiling_submission
tools.description: Contacts the court's e-filing service and withdraws a pending submission that the clerk has not yet accepted. The withdrawn submission is permanently cancelled and cannot be brought back.

params.name: envelope_id
params.description: E-filing envelope ID returned when the submission was made.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for the withdrawal, recorded by the court system.

tools.code:
import os

import requests

EFILING_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("EFILING_BASE_URL", "https://efile.courts.example.gov/api/v2")


def withdraw_court_efiling_submission(envelope_id: str, reason: str) -> dict:
    response = requests.delete(
        f"{EFILING_BASE_URL}/envelopes/{envelope_id}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['EFILING_API_TOKEN']}"},
        json={"withdrawal_reason": reason},
        timeout=30,
    )
    result = {"envelope_id": envelope_id, "status_code": response.status_code, "withdrawn": response.ok}
    if not response.ok:
        result["error"] = response.text[:500]
    return result

tools.name: archive_closed_matter_files
tools.description: Moves a closed matter's document folder from the active matters share into the records archive, under a folder for the year it closed. If a folder with that name is already in the archive, the moved folder gets a numbered suffix.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter number whose folder should be archived, e.g. '2026-LIT-0142'.

params.name: closed_year
params.description: Year the matter closed, used to choose the archive subfolder.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, report where the folder would go without moving it.
